name: M5 Ultra (512GB): Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: MLX-LM Metal backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, 4-bit quantization, 512GB unified memory
notes: M5 Ultra with 512GB unified memory at 1.2TB/s. A 70B model at 4-bit requires ~35GB of weights, fitting with massive room for KV cache. The 1.2TB/s bandwidth yields ~35 tokens/sec for decode, approaching discrete GPU performance. The M5 Ultra is the only consumer chip that can rival a discrete GPU for 70B inference while also offering 512GB capacity.
